source='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    width = len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1

    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    color = next(value for value in counts if value not in (0, background))
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == color]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in points)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in points]
    max_r = max(r for r, c in shape)
    max_c = max(c for r, c in shape)

    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height - max_r):
        for c in range(width - max_c):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    result[r + dr][c + dc] = color
    return result
'''
